contractCases.expected: Root is nav with default aria-label=breadcrumb; List/Item are ol/li. BreadcrumbLink defaults to anchor through useRender. BreadcrumbPage is a nonfocusable span role=link, aria-disabled=true and aria-current=page. Separator/Ellipsis are presentation and aria-hidden; the hidden More text inside Ellipsis does not make an interactive overflow control. A real overflow menu must be explicitly composed.

Tab visits real ancestor links; Enter follows their href. Current page and separators are not made focusable. No root arrow navigation, roving focus or path state is implemented. Caller/router supplies updated ancestors and the current page after navigation.
